```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD CMS CONTENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

with open("../../content/whalewatch_products.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def md(value):
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )

hero = data.get("hero", {})
maps = data.get("maps", {})
indicator = data.get("indicator", {})
faqs = data.get("faqs", {})
disclaimer = data.get("disclaimer", {})

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# MAP OPTIONS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

map_options = maps.get("options", [])

map_options_html = "".join(
    f'<option value="{safe(item.get("url"))}">{safe(item.get("label"))}</option>'
    for item in map_options
)

initial_map = map_options[0].get("url", "") if map_options else ""

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# FAQ ACCORDIONS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

faq_html = ""

for item in faqs.get("items", []):

    image_html = ""

    if item.get("image"):
        image_html = f"""
        <figure class="cw-whale-products-faq-figure">
          <img
            src="{safe(item.get('image'))}"
            alt="{safe(item.get('image_alt'))}"
            loading="lazy"
          >
          <figcaption>{safe(item.get('image_alt'))}</figcaption>
        </figure>
        """

    faq_html += f"""
    <details class="cw-whale-products-accordion">

      <summary>
        <span>{safe(item.get('question'))}</span>
        <span class="cw-whale-products-accordion-icon"
              aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-whale-products-accordion-body">
        {md(item.get('answer'))}
        {image_html}
      </div>

    </details>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-whale cw-whale-products">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-whale-topbar">

    <nav class="cw-whale-tabs" aria-label="WhaleWatch navigation">

      <a class="cw-whale-tab" href="whalewatch.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab" href="about-whalewatch.html">
        About WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab is-active"
         href="whalewatch-products.html"
         aria-current="page">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Products
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab" href="whalewatch-explorer.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- PAGE HERO -->
  <section class="cw-whale-products-hero">

    <span class="cw-whale-products-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>

  <!-- TWO-COLUMN PRODUCTS LAYOUT -->
  <div class="cw-whale-products-dashboard-grid">

    <!-- LEFT COLUMN: RECENT MAP VIEWER -->
    <section class="cw-whale-products-dashboard-panel">

      <div class="cw-whale-products-heading">

        <span class="cw-whale-products-section-label">
          DAILY HABITAT PREDICTIONS
        </span>

        <h2>{safe(maps.get('title'))}</h2>

        <p>{safe(maps.get('description'))}</p>

      </div>

      <div class="cw-whale-products-map-card">

        <div class="cw-whale-products-map-toolbar">

          <label for="mapSelect">
            {safe(maps.get('selector_label'))}
          </label>

          <select id="mapSelect" class="cw-whale-products-select">
            {map_options_html}
          </select>

        </div>

        <div class="cw-whale-products-map-container">

          <img
            id="mapFrame"
            src="{safe(initial_map)}"
            alt="Most recent WhaleWatch 2.0 blue whale habitat suitability map"
          >

        </div>

      </div>

    </section>

    <!-- RIGHT COLUMN: INDICATOR AND FAQS -->
    <div class="cw-whale-products-dashboard-panel cw-whale-products-right-column">

      <!-- SHIPPING LANE INDICATOR -->
      <section class="cw-whale-products-indicator-section">

        <div class="cw-whale-products-heading">

          <span class="cw-whale-products-section-label">
            SHIPPING LANE INDICATOR
          </span>

          <h2>{safe(indicator.get('title'))}</h2>

        </div>

        <div class="cw-whale-products-indicator-card">

          <img
            id="lanes-indicator-img"
            src="{safe(indicator.get('image'))}"
            data-base-url="{safe(indicator.get('image'))}"
            alt="{safe(indicator.get('image_alt'))}"
            loading="lazy"
          >

        </div>

      </section>

      <!-- FAQS -->
      <section class="cw-whale-products-faq-section">

        <div class="cw-whale-products-heading">

          <span class="cw-whale-products-section-label">
            HELP AND INFORMATION
          </span>

          <h2>{safe(faqs.get('title'))}</h2>

        </div>

        <div class="cw-whale-products-accordion-list">
          {faq_html}
        </div>

      </section>

    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- DISCLAIMER -->
  <section class="cw-whale-products-disclaimer">
    {md(disclaimer.get('text'))}
  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  function initializeWhaleWatchProducts() {

    const mapSelect = document.getElementById("mapSelect");
    const mapFrame = document.getElementById("mapFrame");
    const laneImg = document.getElementById("lanes-indicator-img");

    // Update the displayed map when a date is selected
    if (mapSelect && mapFrame) {
      mapSelect.addEventListener("change", function () {
        mapFrame.src = this.value;
      });
    }

    // Refresh the shipping lane indicator image
    if (laneImg) {
      const baseUrl = laneImg.dataset.baseUrl;

      if (baseUrl) {
        const separator = baseUrl.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
        laneImg.src = baseUrl + separator + "t=" + Date.now();
      }
    }

  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      initializeWhaleWatchProducts
    );
  } else {
    initializeWhaleWatchProducts();
  }

})();
</script>
```
